---
title: "ΨMCA 2026"
subtitle: "Pre-Conference Workgroup Meeting<br>Workgroup 1: Validation of Classification"
author:
  - "Dan Mungas"
  - "Jingxuan Wang"
date: "August 5, 2026"
format:
  revealjs:
    theme: default
    slide-number: c/t
    date-format: "MMM D, YYYY"
    footer: "ΨMCA 2026 | Workgroup 1 | Pre-Conference Meeting"
    transition: slide
    background-transition: fade
    width: 1280
    height: 720
    margin: 0.08
    center: false
    navigation-mode: linear
    slide-level: 2
    progress: false
    controls: true
    loop: false
    hash: false
    title-slide-attributes:
      data-background-color: "#1B3A5C"
    include-in-header:
      text: |
        <style>
        :root {
          --navy: #1b3a5c;
          --teal: #00878a;
          --light-blue: #d6e8f7;
          --soft-bg: #f4f7fb;
          --green: #00875a;
          --light-green: #e8f8f5;
          --text: #2c3e50;
          --muted: #66717e;
        }

        .reveal {
          background: var(--soft-bg);
        }

        .reveal h2 {
          color: var(--navy);
          font-weight: 800;
          margin-bottom: 0.35em;
        }

        .reveal p {
          line-height: 1.4;
        }

        /* Agenda slide */
        .agenda-grid {
          display: grid;
          grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
          gap: 16px;
          margin-top: 22px;
        }

        .agenda-card {
          display: grid;
          grid-template-columns: 58px minmax(0, 1fr) auto;
          align-items: center;
          column-gap: 16px;
          min-height: 92px;
          padding: 14px 18px;
          background: #ffffff;
          border: 1px solid var(--light-blue);
          border-left: 6px solid var(--teal);
          border-radius: 12px;
          box-shadow: 0 5px 15px rgba(27, 58, 92, 0.10);
        }

        .agenda-number {
          display: flex;
          align-items: center;
          justify-content: center;
          width: 52px;
          height: 52px;
          border-radius: 50%;
          background: var(--navy);
          color: #ffffff;
          font-size: 21px;
          font-weight: 800;
        }

        .agenda-content {
          min-width: 0;
          color: var(--text);
          font-size: 22px;
          font-weight: 650;
          line-height: 1.15;
        }

        .agenda-time {
          padding: 6px 11px;
          background: var(--light-green);
          color: var(--green);
          border-radius: 999px;
          font-size: 13px;
          font-weight: 700;
          white-space: nowrap;
        }

        .recording-note {
          margin-top: 34px;
          padding: 8px 12px;
          color: #6f7782;
          font-size: 0.42em;
          line-height: 1.3;
          text-align: left;
          border-left: 4px solid var(--teal);
        }

        /* Introductions slide */
        .intro-layout {
          display: grid;
          grid-template-columns: 0.92fr 1.08fr;
          gap: 24px;
          margin-top: 18px;
          align-items: stretch;
        }

        .intro-welcome {
          position: relative;
          overflow: hidden;
          min-height: 430px;
          padding: 32px 36px;
          background:
            radial-gradient(
              circle at 88% 12%,
              rgba(0, 135, 138, 0.30) 0,
              rgba(0, 135, 138, 0) 35%
            ),
            linear-gradient(145deg, #1b3a5c 0%, #214f76 100%);
          color: #ffffff;
          border-radius: 18px;
          box-shadow: 0 12px 28px rgba(27, 58, 92, 0.18);
        }

        .intro-welcome::after {
          content: "Ψ";
          position: absolute;
          right: -18px;
          bottom: -88px;
          color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.055);
          font-size: 300px;
          font-weight: 800;
          line-height: 1;
        }

        .intro-eyebrow,
        .intro-psymca,
        .intro-tagline,
        .intro-divider,
        .intro-message,
        .intro-highlight,
        .intro-closing {
          position: relative;
          z-index: 1;
        }

        .intro-eyebrow {
          color: #9edfe0;
          font-size: 14px;
          font-weight: 800;
          letter-spacing: 0.18em;
        }

        .intro-psymca {
          margin-top: 8px;
          color: #ffffff;
          font-size: 50px;
          font-weight: 800;
          line-height: 1;
        }

        .intro-tagline {
          max-width: 90%;
          margin-top: 12px;
          color: var(--light-blue);
          font-size: 16px;
          line-height: 1.35;
        }

        .intro-divider {
          width: 70px;
          height: 5px;
          margin: 25px 0 23px;
          background: #00a3a6;
          border-radius: 999px;
        }

        .intro-message {
          color: #ffffff;
          font-size: 19px;
          line-height: 1.45;
        }

        .intro-highlight {
          margin-top: 23px;
          padding: 13px 15px;
          background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.11);
          border-left: 5px solid #5ad0d2;
          border-radius: 8px;
          color: #ffffff;
          font-size: 18px;
          font-weight: 700;
          line-height: 1.35;
        }

        .intro-closing {
          margin-top: 23px;
          color: #9edfe0;
          font-size: 22px;
          font-weight: 800;
        }

        .intro-prompt {
          min-height: 430px;
          padding: 26px 28px;
          background: #ffffff;
          border: 1px solid var(--light-blue);
          border-radius: 18px;
          box-shadow: 0 12px 28px rgba(27, 58, 92, 0.10);
        }

        .intro-prompt h3 {
          margin: 0 0 10px 0 !important;
          padding: 0 0 11px 0 !important;
          color: var(--navy) !important;
          border-bottom: 3px solid var(--teal) !important;
          font-size: 25px !important;
          font-weight: 750;
        }

        .intro-instruction {
          margin: 10px 0 15px;
          color: var(--muted);
          font-size: 15px;
        }

        .intro-item {
          display: grid;
          grid-template-columns: 40px minmax(0, 1fr);
          align-items: center;
          gap: 14px;
          margin-bottom: 12px;
          padding: 12px 14px;
          background: var(--soft-bg);
          border-left: 4px solid var(--teal);
          border-radius: 10px;
        }

        .intro-number {
          display: flex;
          align-items: center;
          justify-content: center;
          width: 36px;
          height: 36px;
          background: var(--teal);
          color: #ffffff;
          border-radius: 50%;
          font-size: 12px;
          font-weight: 800;
        }

        .intro-item-text {
          color: var(--text);
          font-size: 16px;
          line-height: 1.25;
        }

        /* About Our Workgroup slide */
        .wg-overview {
          margin-top: 16px;
        }

        .wg-hero {
          padding: 22px 28px;
          background:
            radial-gradient(
              circle at 92% 20%,
              rgba(0, 135, 138, 0.30),
              rgba(0, 135, 138, 0) 34%
            ),
            linear-gradient(135deg, #1b3a5c 0%, #245d88 100%);
          color: #ffffff;
          border-radius: 16px;
          box-shadow: 0 10px 24px rgba(27, 58, 92, 0.16);
        }

        .wg-label {
          color: #9edfe0;
          font-size: 13px;
          font-weight: 800;
          letter-spacing: 0.16em;
        }

        .wg-title {
          margin-top: 5px;
          color: #ffffff;
          font-size: 34px;
          font-weight: 800;
          line-height: 1.1;
        }

        .wg-subtitle {
          max-width: 90%;
          margin-top: 8px;
          color: #d6e8f7;
          font-size: 16px;
          line-height: 1.4;
        }

        .wg-grid {
          display: grid;
          grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));
          gap: 16px;
          margin-top: 17px;
        }

        .wg-card {
          min-height: 150px;
          padding: 18px 18px 17px;
          background: #ffffff;
          border: 1px solid #d6e8f7;
          border-top: 5px solid #00878a;
          border-radius: 12px;
          box-shadow: 0 5px 15px rgba(27, 58, 92, 0.08);
        }

        .wg-icon {
          display: flex;
          align-items: center;
          justify-content: center;
          width: 34px;
          height: 34px;
          margin-bottom: 10px;
          background: #e8f8f5;
          color: #00878a;
          border-radius: 50%;
          font-size: 12px;
          font-weight: 800;
        }

        .wg-card-title {
          color: #1b3a5c;
          font-size: 19px;
          font-weight: 750;
          margin-bottom: 7px;
        }

        .wg-card-text {
          color: #5f6c78;
          font-size: 13.5px;
          line-height: 1.38;
        }

        .wg-comparison {
          margin-top: 17px;
          padding: 15px 18px;
          background: #eef4f9;
          border-radius: 12px;
        }

        .wg-comparison-title {
          margin-bottom: 11px;
          color: #1b3a5c;
          font-size: 15px;
          font-weight: 800;
          text-transform: uppercase;
          letter-spacing: 0.05em;
        }

        .wg-pill-row {
          display: grid;
          grid-template-columns: 1fr auto 1fr auto 1fr;
          align-items: center;
          gap: 10px;
        }

        .wg-pill {
          padding: 9px 12px;
          background: #ffffff;
          color: #1b3a5c;
          border: 1px solid #c9deef;
          border-radius: 999px;
          text-align: center;
          font-size: 13px;
          font-weight: 700;
        }

        .wg-arrow {
          color: #00878a;
          font-size: 21px;
          font-weight: 800;
        }

        .wg-validation {
          display: grid;
          grid-template-columns: auto repeat(3, 1fr);
          gap: 9px;
          align-items: center;
          margin-top: 12px;
        }

        .wg-validation-label {
          color: #66717e;
          font-size: 12px;
          font-weight: 700;
        }
        .wg-validation-item-long {
          width: 1120px;
          padding: 7px 9px;
          font-size: 12px;
          font-weight: 650;
          background: #d6e8f7;
          color: #1b3a5c;
          border-radius: 999px;
          text-align: center;
        }

        .wg-validation-item {
          padding: 7px 9px;
          background: #d6e8f7;
          color: #1b3a5c;
          border-radius: 7px;
          text-align: center;
          font-size: 12px;
          font-weight: 650;
        }

        .wg-dataset {
          display: flex;
          align-items: center;
          gap: 12px;
          margin-top: 14px;
          padding: 10px 15px;
          background: #fff3cd;
          border-left: 5px solid #f0a500;
          border-radius: 8px;
        }

        .wg-dataset-label {
          color: #8a6200;
          font-size: 11px;
          font-weight: 800;
          letter-spacing: 0.12em;
        }

        .wg-dataset-name {
          color: #5f4b12;
          font-size: 14px;
          font-weight: 700;
        }

        @media (max-width: 900px) {
          .agenda-grid,
          .intro-layout,
          .wg-grid {
            grid-template-columns: 1fr;
          }

          .wg-pill-row,
          .wg-validation {
            grid-template-columns: 1fr;
          }

          .wg-arrow {
            display: none;
          }
        }
        

        /* Potential Project Ideas slide */
        
        .project-intro {
          margin: 4px 0 18px;
          color: var(--muted);
          font-size: 15px;
          font-style: italic;
        }
        
        .project-grid {
          display: grid;
          grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
          gap: 20px;
          margin-top: 12px;
        }
        .project-card {
          position: relative;
          min-height: 270px;
          padding: 20px 20px 18px;
          background: #ffffff;
          border: 1px solid var(--light-blue);
          border-top: 5px solid var(--teal);
          border-radius: 14px;
          box-shadow: 0 6px 18px rgba(27, 58, 92, 0.09);
        }
        
        .project-letter {
          display: flex;
          align-items: center;
          justify-content: center;
          width: 42px;
          height: 42px;
          margin-bottom: 14px;
          background: var(--navy);
          color: #ffffff;
          border-radius: 50%;
          font-size: 17px;
          font-weight: 800;
        }
        
        .project-title {
          margin-bottom: 10px;
          color: var(--navy);
          font-size: 20px;
          font-weight: 800;
          line-height: 1.2;
        }
        
        .project-description {
          color: #5f6c78;
          font-size: 14px;
          line-height: 1.45;
        }
        
        .project-methods {
          position: absolute;
          left: 20px;
          right: 20px;
          bottom: 18px;
          padding-top: 12px;
          border-top: 1px solid #dce8f2;
          color: var(--teal);
          font-size: 12px;
          font-weight: 700;
          line-height: 1.35;
        }
        
        .project-methods-label {
          margin-right: 4px;
          color: var(--muted);
          font-size: 11px;
          font-weight: 800;
          letter-spacing: 0.06em;
          text-transform: uppercase;
        }
        
        .project-footer {
          display: grid;
          grid-template-columns: auto minmax(0, 1fr);
          align-items: center;
          gap: 14px;
          margin-top: 18px;
          padding: 14px 18px;
          background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--teal), #087477);
          color: #ffffff;
          border-radius: 12px;
          box-shadow: 0 6px 16px rgba(0, 135, 138, 0.16);
        }
        
        .project-footer-icon {
          display: flex;
          align-items: center;
          justify-content: center;
          width: 42px;
          height: 42px;
          background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.16);
          border-radius: 50%;
          font-size: 22px;
          font-weight: 800;
        }
        
        .project-footer-title {
          margin-bottom: 2px;
          font-size: 15px;
          font-weight: 800;
        }
        
        .project-footer-text {
          color: #e7ffff;
          font-size: 13px;
          line-height: 1.35;
        }
        
        @media (max-width: 900px) {
          .project-grid {
            grid-template-columns: 1fr;
          }
        
          .project-card {
            min-height: 190px;
          }
        }

        /* Structure and Roles slide */
        
        .roles-layout {
          display: grid;
          grid-template-columns: 0.72fr 1.28fr;
          gap: 20px;
          margin-top: 16px;
        }
        
        .roles-leads {
          padding: 24px;
          background:
            radial-gradient(
              circle at 88% 12%,
              rgba(0, 135, 138, 0.28),
              rgba(0, 135, 138, 0) 35%
            ),
            linear-gradient(145deg, #1b3a5c 0%, #245d88 100%);
          color: #ffffff;
          border-radius: 16px;
          box-shadow: 0 10px 24px rgba(27, 58, 92, 0.16);
        }
        
        .roles-eyebrow {
          color: #9edfe0;
          font-size: 12px;
          font-weight: 800;
          letter-spacing: 0.16em;
        }
        
        .roles-heading {
          margin-top: 6px;
          color: #ffffff;
          font-size: 28px;
          font-weight: 800;
        }
        
        .roles-lead-card {
          margin-top: 16px;
          padding: 15px 16px;
          background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.10);
          border-left: 5px solid #5ad0d2;
          border-radius: 10px;
        }
        
        .roles-lead-name {
          color: #ffffff;
          font-size: 19px;
          font-weight: 800;
        }
        
        .roles-lead-role {
          margin-top: 4px;
          color: #d6e8f7;
          font-size: 13px;
          line-height: 1.35;
        }
        
        .roles-shared {
          margin-top: 18px;
          padding-top: 15px;
          border-top: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.22);
        }
        
        .roles-shared-title {
          color: #9edfe0;
          font-size: 12px;
          font-weight: 800;
          letter-spacing: 0.08em;
          text-transform: uppercase;
        }
        
        .roles-shared-text {
          margin-top: 6px;
          color: #ffffff;
          font-size: 13px;
          line-height: 1.4;
        }
        
        .roles-workflow {
          display: grid;
          gap: 12px;
        }
        
        .role-step {
          display: grid;
          grid-template-columns: 46px minmax(0,1fr);
          gap: 12px;
          align-items: center;
        
          padding: 12px 15px;
          margin-bottom: 10px;
        
          background: #ffffff;
          border: 1px solid var(--light-blue);
          border-left: 5px solid var(--teal);
          border-radius: 12px;
        
          box-shadow: 0 5px 14px rgba(27,58,92,0.08);
        }
        
        .role-step-title{
          font-size:16px;
        }
        
        .role-step-text{
          font-size:12px;
          line-height:1.3;
        }
        
        .role-step-number {
          display: flex;
          align-items: center;
          justify-content: center;
          width: 42px;
          height: 42px;
          background: var(--navy);
          color: #ffffff;
          border-radius: 50%;
          font-size: 13px;
          font-weight: 800;
        }
        
        .roles-principle {
          display: grid;
          grid-template-columns: auto minmax(0, 1fr);
          align-items: center;
          gap: 13px;
          margin-top: 14px;
          padding: 13px 16px;
          background: #fff3cd;
          border-left: 5px solid #f0a500;
          border-radius: 10px;
        }
        
        .roles-principle-icon {
          font-size: 24px;
        }
        
        .roles-principle-title {
          color: #6f5300;
          font-size: 14px;
          font-weight: 800;
        }
        
        .roles-principle-text {
          margin-top: 2px;
          color: #6f5d24;
          font-size: 12.5px;
          line-height: 1.35;
        }

        /* Goals, expectations, and culture */
        
        .culture-grid {
          display: grid;
          grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr));
          gap: 18px;
          margin-top: 20px;
        }
        
        .culture-panel {
          min-height: 390px;
          padding: 24px 22px;
          border-radius: 16px;
          box-shadow: 0 8px 20px rgba(27, 58, 92, 0.10);
        }
        
        .culture-panel-navy {
          background: linear-gradient(145deg, #1b3a5c, #245d88);
          color: #ffffff;
        }
        
        .culture-panel-blue {
          background: #ffffff;
          color: var(--text);
          border: 1px solid var(--light-blue);
          border-top: 6px solid var(--teal);
        }
        
        .culture-panel-green {
          background: #e8f8f5;
          color: var(--text);
          border-top: 6px solid var(--green);
        }
        
        .culture-label {
          margin-bottom: 8px;
          font-size: 12px;
          font-weight: 800;
          letter-spacing: 0.12em;
          text-transform: uppercase;
        }
        
        .culture-panel-navy .culture-label {
          color: #9edfe0;
        }
        
        .culture-panel-blue .culture-label {
          color: var(--teal);
        }
        
        .culture-panel-green .culture-label {
          color: var(--green);
        }
        
        .culture-title {
          margin-bottom: 20px;
          font-size: 24px;
          font-weight: 800;
          line-height: 1.15;
        }
        
        .culture-item {
          display: grid;
          grid-template-columns: 28px minmax(0, 1fr);
          gap: 10px;
          align-items: start;
          margin-bottom: 16px;
          font-size: 15px;
          line-height: 1.35;
        }
        
        .culture-check {
          display: flex;
          align-items: center;
          justify-content: center;
          width: 24px;
          height: 24px;
          border-radius: 50%;
          font-size: 12px;
          font-weight: 800;
        }
        
        .culture-panel-navy .culture-check {
          background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15);
          color: #ffffff;
        }
        
        .culture-panel-blue .culture-check {
          background: #e8f8f5;
          color: var(--green);
        }
        
        .culture-panel-green .culture-check {
          background: #ffffff;
          color: var(--green);
        }
        
        /* First-time attendees */
        
        .firsttime-layout {
          display: grid;
          grid-template-columns: 1.05fr 0.95fr;
          gap: 22px;
          margin-top: 18px;
        }
        
        .firsttime-cards {
          display: grid;
          grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
          gap: 14px;
        }
        
        .firsttime-card {
          min-height: 170px;
          padding: 20px;
          background: #ffffff;
          border: 1px solid var(--light-blue);
          border-top: 5px solid var(--teal);
          border-radius: 14px;
          box-shadow: 0 6px 16px rgba(27, 58, 92, 0.08);
        }
        
        .firsttime-icon {
          margin-bottom: 10px;
          font-size: 28px;
        }
        
        .firsttime-title {
          margin-bottom: 7px;
          color: var(--navy);
          font-size: 18px;
          font-weight: 800;
        }
        
        .firsttime-text {
          color: #5f6c78;
          font-size: 13.5px;
          line-height: 1.4;
        }
        
        .firsttime-links {
          min-height: 380px;
          padding: 26px;
          background: linear-gradient(145deg, #1b3a5c, #245d88);
          color: #ffffff;
          border-radius: 16px;
          box-shadow: 0 10px 24px rgba(27, 58, 92, 0.16);
        }
        
        .firsttime-links-title {
          margin-bottom: 20px;
          color: #ffffff;
          font-size: 24px;
          font-weight: 800;
        }
        
        .firsttime-link {
          margin-bottom: 17px;
          padding-bottom: 15px;
          border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.18);
        }
        
        .firsttime-link-label {
          color: #9edfe0;
          font-size: 12px;
          font-weight: 800;
          letter-spacing: 0.07em;
          text-transform: uppercase;
        }
        
        .firsttime-link a {
          color: #ffffff !important;
          font-size: 14px;
          font-weight: 700;
          text-decoration: none;
        }
        
        .firsttime-contact {
          margin-top: 20px;
          color: #d6e8f7;
          font-size: 13px;
          line-height: 1.5;
        }
        
        /* Authorship */
        
        .authorship-intro {
          margin: 4px 0 18px;
          color: var(--muted);
          font-size: 15px;
          font-style: italic;
        }
        
        .authorship-grid {
          display: grid;
          grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
          gap: 14px;
        }
        
        .authorship-card {
          display: grid;
          grid-template-columns: 46px minmax(0, 1fr);
          gap: 14px;
          align-items: start;

## About Our Workgroup

```{=html}
<div class="wg-overview">

  <div class="wg-hero">
    <div class="wg-label">WORKGROUP 1</div>
    <div class="wg-title">Validation of Classification</div>
    <div class="wg-subtitle">
      How well do clinical and algorithmic classifications reflect underlying disease and predict future cognitive decline?
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="wg-grid">
    <div class="wg-card">
      <div class="wg-icon">01</div>
      <div class="wg-card-title">Why this matters</div>
      <div class="wg-card-text">
        Clinical diagnosis is widely used to stage cognitive impairment and brain injury or degeneration, and to predict future decline.
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="wg-card">
      <div class="wg-icon">02</div>
      <div class="wg-card-title">The current gap</div>
      <div class="wg-card-text">
        Algorithmic classifications are often evaluated against clinical diagnosis as the "gold standard," but both approaches are rarely compared directly against external validation criteria.
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="wg-card">
      <div class="wg-icon">03</div>
      <div class="wg-card-title">Our goal</div>
      <div class="wg-card-text">
        Validate clinical diagnosis, algorithmic classification, and machine learning predictions against disease biomarkers and future progression of cognitive impairment.
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="wg-comparison">
    <div class="wg-comparison-title">Classification approaches we will compare</div>

   <div class="wg-validation">
      <div class="wg-validation-label">We will validate </div>
      <div class="wg-validation-item-long">clinical, algorithmic classification, and machine learning-based predictions</div>
    </div>

    <div class="wg-validation">
      <div class="wg-validation-label"> against</div>
      <div class="wg-validation-item">longitudinal MRI</div>
      <div class="wg-validation-item">other disease biomarkers</div>
      <div class="wg-validation-item">future cognitive progression</div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="wg-dataset">
    <span class="wg-dataset-label">DATASET</span>
    <span class="wg-dataset-name">UC Davis Alzheimer's Disease Research Center</span>
  </div>

</div>
```

## Structure and Roles

```{=html}

      <div class="role-step-text">
        Participants will join a project based on scientific interests,
        methodological experience, and learning goals.
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="role-step">
    <div class="role-step-number">04</div>
    <div>
      <div class="role-step-title">Define individual responsibilities</div>
      <div class="role-step-text">
        Assign clear roles such as literature review, coding, analysis,
        visualization, interpretation, or writing.
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="role-step">
    <div class="role-step-number">05</div>
    <div>
      <div class="role-step-title">Collaborate throughout the week</div>
      <div class="role-step-text">
        Work closely with teammates, share ideas, review code, and support
        each other's progress.
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="role-step">
    <div class="role-step-number">06</div>
    <div>
      <div class="role-step-title">Daily check-ins</div>
      <div class="role-step-text">
        Set daily goals, review progress, troubleshoot barriers, and adjust
        tasks as needed.
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="roles-principle">
    <div class="roles-principle-icon">◎</div>
    <div>
      <div class="roles-principle-title">Our guiding principle</div>
      <div class="roles-principle-text">
        Everyone should have a meaningful opportunity to contribute, and,
        where feasible, everyone should work directly with the data.
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

</div>
```

## Authorship - Let's Talk About It Early

<div class="authorship-intro">
We will revisit authorship on Day 1 in Tahoe. These are guiding principles rather than fixed mandates.
</div>

```{=html}
<div class="authorship-grid">

  <div class="authorship-card">
    <div class="authorship-number">01</div>
    <div>
      <div class="authorship-title">Start the conversation early</div>
      <div class="authorship-text">
        Discuss potential roles, products, and authorship expectations
        when projects and subgroups are established.
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="authorship-card">
    <div class="authorship-number">02</div>
    <div>
      <div class="authorship-title">Encourage junior leadership</div>
      <div class="authorship-text">
        Junior members should be supported in considering first-author roles,
        while senior members may contribute in senior or supporting positions.
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
  
    <div class="authorship-card">
    <div class="authorship-number">03</div>
    <div>
      <div class="authorship-title">The first author leads</div>
      <div class="authorship-text">
        First authorship involves substantial responsibility for coordination,
        drafting, revisions, and moving the project toward completion.
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="authorship-card">
    <div class="authorship-number">04</div>
    <div>
      <div class="authorship-title">Authorship requires contribution</div>
      <div class="authorship-text">
        Contributions may include analysis, coding, interpretation, writing,
        visualization, or substantive review. Membership alone is not sufficient.
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="authorship-card">
    <div class="authorship-number">05</div>
    <div>
      <div class="authorship-title">Order reflects contribution</div>
      <div class="authorship-text">
        Authorship order should reflect relative substantive contributions,
        not career stage or seniority.
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>



</div>

<div class="authorship-note">
  <div class="authorship-note-icon">✦</div>
  <div class="authorship-note-text">
    Each workgroup may adapt these norms. We will aim for transparency,
    fairness, and ongoing discussion as contributions evolve.
  </div>
</div>
```
